about: capturePage and the headless port capture contain no native chrome, so the macOS traffic lights need no mask: their area is the alpha-0 vibrancy backdrop on both sides. Per-platform masks of PLAN section 2.5 gate 5, keyed by process.platform as run.json records it. Rects are CSS px of the window content; deviceRow and deviceColumn are device pixels, negative from the bottom or right; transparent masks pixels with alpha 0 on both sides (alpha 0 on one side only is compared). Per-capture masks (webviews, scrollbars, scenario selectors) come from the capture records of both sides.
